title: Hollywood Identity Bias Dataset: A Context Oriented Bias Analysis of Movie Dialogues
reasoning: The paper introduces and benchmarks a dataset specifically designed to identify various social biases in movie dialogues. One of the seven core categories annotated and evaluated is 'religion'. The dataset includes targets such as 'Christian, Judaism, Aethist, Islam etc.', and the experimental section reports model performance on detecting religious bias. This constitutes a direct evaluation and benchmarking component related to religion.
